rules.statement: A certificate issued under section 146 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance is conclusive evidence of the title of the Council to the property and cannot be impugned on the ground of a fundamental infirmity.
rules.supporting_quote: "When land is purchased by the Municipal Council, a certificate issued under section 146 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance is conclusive evidence of the title of the Council to the property. Such a certificate cannot be impugned on the ground of a fundamental infirmity attaching to it."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Municipal Councils Ordinance-Purchase of land by Council-Certificate of title-Conclusive evidence-Ordinance No. 6 of 1910, s. 146.
